### **Company Honored by Compact Equipment magazine**


**Milwaukee, WI (November 26, 2024)** – Douglas Dynamics, Inc. (NYSE: PLOW), North America’s premier manufacturer and upfitter of commercial work truck attachments and equipment, proudly announces that one of its leading snow and ice control brands, WESTERN, has received the 2024 Innovative Iron Award from Compact Equipment magazine for the WESTERN PILE DRIVER XL.


Compact Equipment, an industry-leading magazine, evaluates versatile construction equipment through trade shows, product launches, and demos to select the year’s Innovative Iron Award winners, recognizing outstanding models in the market.


The WESTERN PILE DRIVER XL hydraulic wing pushers distinguished themselves with exceptional versatility and performance in the construction, landscaping, and agriculture sectors.


The Innovative Iron Award is featured in the November/December Digital Edition of Compact Equipment. For more details about the award and the full list of honorees, visit[compactequip.com](https://digital.compactequip.com/november-december-2024/page-32) .


For more information about the WESTERN PILE DRIVER XL and other WESTERN equipment, please visit[westernplows.com/](https://westernplows.com/) .
